label: D2 after a2 led commonly to S2, early-mid episode (trials 3-49)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the input shows a2 was chosen and S2 was reached (a common transition). Never fires at D1/GO, after a1, or on S1 or rare transitions. It is also limited to episode trials 3-49 (peak 10-29, none after about trial 55) and to a narrow band of model value (about 7.9-8.3). Within that support it fires on only about 15% of steps, so precision is low. It is sporadic: it is strongest on the first one or two a2->S2 common trials after an S1 visit or an unrewarded trial, and decays across a run of consecutive S2 common trials (e.g. 0.94 -> 0.41 -> 0.18). Adding the value band raises dev F1 only slightly (0.26 -> 0.28), so the simpler predicate was recorded. All variables used are observed at D2.
